About Kem

Good systems make room to grow.

I help businesses build connected digital systems, from CRM and automation to websites, apps and community onboarding. Understand what needs to work, choose a useful set of tools, then connect the pieces.

The habit comes from maths. I am finishing a B.Sc. at Obafemi Awolowo University, and the thinking that makes a proof hold makes an automation hold: define the inputs, remove the ambiguity, let it run without you.
